name: cortico-provider-humanize
description: Cortico provider for Coopanion: wraps the app's own Coo connection and holds each reply until the Humanize World has written the pet's inner thought, then sends it along with the person's words
author: abbabanana

cortico.displayName: 活人感（包住 Coo 连接）

zh.displayName: 活人感（包住 Coo 连接）
zh.description: 和「活人感」World 搭配：你对桌宠说话时，先等 World 想好桌宠的心情，再连同你的话一起发给模型，省掉 humanize_feel 那一轮。World 关着时就是普通的 Coo 连接。

en.description: Pairs with the Humanize World: each time you speak to the pet, waits for the World to write the pet's inner thought and sends it along with your words, saving the humanize_feel round. With the World off it is a plain Coo connection.
